entities.summary: Mira Seth is an Indian civil servant, diplomat, women's rights activist, and a former chairman of UNICEF. Born in 1968 in Delhi, India, she was the daughter of a former Indian diplomat. She graduated from the University of Delhi with a degree in political science and later earned a master's in public administration from the University of Michigan. Seth's entry into politics began in 2007 when she was elected to the Indian National Congress. She served as a Member of Parliament for the South Delhi constituency from 2014 to 2019. In 2019, she was appointed as the chairperson of UNICEF India, a position she held until 2022. During her tenure, she focused on issues such as education, health, and child rights. Seth has been recognized for her work on women's rights and has received several awards, including the Padma Shri in 2020. She has also written several books on women's empowerment and has been a vocal advocate for women's rights in India. Mira Seth is a prominent figure in Indian politics and has made significant contributions to the field of women's rights.
